'''Qel-Droma's Grave''', or the '''Echoes of Pain''' was a spot at the landing pads of [[Knossa Spaceport/Legends|Knossa Spaceport]] upon which [[Cay Qel-Droma]] was [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|slain]] by his own brother, [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], in a fit of rage.<ref name="NoP" />

The site was tainted by the action and hallowed in the Force. Wandering off the platform and onto the broad promenade that led out of the city and to the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Library]], Ulic Qel-Droma was stripped of his ability to use the Force by several of his Jedi allies as punishment for his crimes. These actions created a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in the Force, tainting the entire area with [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side energies]]. Shortly after these events, [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] was scorched by the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] and Knossa Spaceport was reduced to twisted stone, metal, and heaps of rubble.<ref name="NoP" /> In [[3994 BBY]], Ulic Qel-Droma made a pilgrimage to the site before visiting [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Sith War 6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref>

In the following centuries, as surviving tribes of Jedi and their descendants reclaimed the world and began calling themselves the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]], this site's potent dark side allure was noted. To ward off the unwary from crossing these vergences, the Ysanna created a thirty-meter perimeter of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech-sized]] black stones around each site. The Ysanna observed that those who crossed the perimeter and entered into the vergence would have their emotions twisted by the Force, seeing their closest friends as their most dangerous of foes.<ref name="NoP" />
